title: Oven-Roasted Kid-Friendly Syrian Chicken Ttukbaegi
description: A kid-friendly version of traditional Syrian ttukbaegi, featuring chicken and melted cheese. This earthenware cookware dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with kosher salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large ttukbaegi or oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the ttukbaegi to the preheated oven and continue cooking for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together the chicken broth and shredded mozzarella and cheddar cheese.
After the chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven and carefully pour the cheese mixture over the top of the chicken.
Return the ttukbaegi to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the ttukbaegi from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley for garnish.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
